enchantment.betterluck.luck.desc: Raises your Luck while worn, improving fishing, mining and combat rewards.
betterluck.configuration.title: Better Luck Effect
betterluck.configuration.luck.tooltip: All bonuses scale with your Luck level, which comes from the Luck effect and the Luck enchantment.
betterluck.configuration.scaling.tooltip: How Luck level converts into a bonus for quantity-based rewards.
betterluck.configuration.bonusByLevel.to: The Nth entry is level N; anything above the table uses the last entry. Chestplate, held tool and other Luck are looked up separately and added together.
betterluck.configuration.combat.tooltip: Extra rare drops need Luck; extra common drops also need a Looting weapon.
betterluck.configuration.rareDropRollsPe: How many extra times the entity loot table is rolled per Luck level. Only rare drops are kept, and already-dropped items are not given again.
betterluck.configuration.rareDropMaxRoll: Upper limit for the value above. 0 disables this bonus.
betterluck.configuration.fishing.tooltip: Chance to upgrade a fishing catch into a treasure roll.
betterluck.configuration.treasureChanceP: Chance per Luck level to replace the catch with a roll on the fishing treasure table.
betterluck.configuration.treasureChanceM: Upper limit for the value above. 0.4 = at most 40%.
betterluck.configuration.chests.tooltip: Only affects the 56 vanilla chest loot tables. Nothing is ever added that was not already there.
betterluck.configuration.goldenAppleChan: Chance per Luck level to turn a whole stack of golden apples into enchanted golden apples.
Upper limit for the value above. 0.4 = at most 40%.
betterluck.configuration.inferiorEnchant: Enchantments whose chance of being rolled is reduced. This one is independent of Luck and only applies to chest loot.
betterluck.configuration.list.tooltip: One entry per line, in the form "<enchantment id>=<keep factor>". 1.0 = no change, 0.25 = about a quarter as likely, 0.0 = never. Entries with a bad format are ignored.
